subject: Re: Kickoff: DP transfer-learning recipe (dp_transfer)
body:
Status on validation, two days before the milestone.

Workload A (product-image classifier): DP-LS on frozen features hits 91.2% at epsilon=8 vs 93.0% non-private — well inside the recipe's promised gap. Workload B (document-type classifier): DP-FC is the winner as the paper predicts for the higher-dimensional feature space, but I hit a real snag: the feature covariance accumulation blows past accelerator memory at our feature dim (4096) with the default config. Fix is chunked accumulation; costs ~20% wall-clock, correctness verified against the reference.

The trade-off to settle before the recipe doc freezes: default to DP-FC with chunking everywhere (simpler story, slower), or keep the per-method decision tree (DP-LS for low-dim, DP-FC for high-dim, DP-Newton where second-order helps). I vote decision tree — it's what the paper's recommendations actually say, and the configs directory already mirrors it.

Milan
